statement: At an arbitrary shallow cubic tangent background U, the relative-class difference for a commuting translation H is additive in H, fixed by the zeta-character and killed by three
depends_on: Explicit cubic block extension and shear identities; C:shallow_commuting_trace
notes: No additivity in the noncommuting background is asserted; f_U(H) is not identified with d(H)

statement: Every shallow deformation of any mixture of L012, Q and regular cubic lattices over Z3[zeta3] semidirect any F3-vector-space is killed by three in the relative Swan group; the same holds for arbitrary signed S3 mixtures
notes: A torsion bound only: neither vanishing nor existence of nonzero three-torsion is asserted. All multiplicities and arbitrary coefficient vector spaces are covered by the written block proof.
